title: bridge: RQ-DRAIN2-PH-01
body:
Automated bridge job `RQ-DRAIN2-PH-01` (pool: devin), single commit on base `e78f74b1f`.

**Tests:** no test command

**Tier-1 (CODEOWNERS) paths, async post-merge review:** .github/scripts/release-cadence.mjs .github/tests/release-cadence.test.mjs src/core/memory/episodic.ts test/config/realio-lane-membership.mjs test/fixtures/authority/tier1-closure.json test/verse-api-mount-310.test.ts

<details><summary>Agent notes</summary>

# BRIDGE_NOTES — RQ-DRAIN2-PH-01

Rework of six conflicting drain PRs in `ashlrai/phantom` onto current `master`
(`da6ba9de8` at time of writing; the default branch is `master`, not `main`).

All changes are intentionally **uncommitted** in the worktree; `publish.sh` owns
publication. No `git push`/`commit`/`gh pr create|merge|close`/`gh api` writes
were performed.

## Environment note

`gh` CLI could not read `~/.config/gh/config.yml` (macOS process-level denial),
so `gh pr view`/`gh pr diff` were unavailable. PR intent was recovered by
fetching `refs/pull/N/head` directly over the public git remote, reading public
GitHub PR pages, and diffing the fetched heads against their merge bases. The
public REST API was used briefly, then rate-limited; HTML pages covered the rest.

## Per-PR outcomes

- `REWORKS_PR: 3913` — **reworked.** Read-only multi-repo PR pipeline snapshot
  (`phm pr cockpit`): `src/core/merge-cockpit.ts`, `src/cli/pr-cockpit.ts`,
  `docs/MERGE-COCKPIT.md`, `test/merge-cockpit.test.ts`, plus CLI dispatch,
  completions, help and docs-index registration. Five-minute cache under
  `~/.phantom/merge-cockpit.json` (mode 0600), bounded GraphQL pagination
  (20 pages / 2000 PRs), hold lists are observation-only; no mutation path.
- `REWORKS_PR: 3907` — **superseded.** The offline ecosystem changelog generator
  (`scripts/generate-ecosystem-changelog.mjs`, fixtures, tests) already landed on
  master via `RQ-DRAIN2-PH-27` (#3967). Ported files are byte-identical except
  `scripts/ECOSYSTEM_CHANGELOG.md`'s test-command line, where master's newer
  hermetic `npm run test:ci` form was kept. Zero residual diff; not duplicated.
- `REWORKS_PR: 3901` — **superseded.** Idle-allowance metrics landed on master
  via `RQ-DRAIN2-PH-39` (`b53beb5a9`) as `src/core/metrics/idle-allowance.ts` +
  `src/cli/metrics-idle.ts` + `docs/IDLE-ALLOWANCE.md` + tests — the same intent
  in newer structure. Not re-ported.
- `REWORKS_PR: 3889` — **reworked.** COS report pages (`phm pages publish|list`,
  `src/core/cos/pages.ts`, loopback `/pages/<slug>` UI route + view, `docs/PAGES.md`,
  `test/cos-pages.test.ts`) and fleet reports `phm fleet precheck-repeats` +
  `phm fleet sticky-loop` with tests and registry entries. The
  `docs/fleet-health.md` ledger-age/stuck-lane text from the PR was already on
  master (idle-lane work), so only genuinely new content was ported.
- `REWORKS_PR: 3881` — **reworked.** Opt-in scrubbed episodic memory
  (`src/core/memory/episodic.ts`, `PHANTOM_EPISODIC_MEMORY=1`, JSONL under
  `~/.ashlr/memory/`, Git blob staleness checks, off by default) and the
  read-only `phantom_fleet_verbs` MCP catalog (`src/core/fleet/fleet-verbs-tool.ts`,
  64-char grep cap, source-file reads only) with docs and tests.
- `REWORKS_PR: 3879` — **reworked.** Two read-only, input-validated fleet MCP
  tools: `fleet_job_current_snapshot` (replay audit at a pinned ancestor commit)
  and `fleet_path_cochanges` (bounded path co-change ranking), registered in
  `tools/list`, arg validation, dispatch, `test/support/fleet-mcp-tools.ts`
  inventory, and real-I/O classified tests.

## Conflict resolutions worth noting

- `src/mcp/fleet-server.ts`: merged my two tools alongside master's newer
  `fleet_job_current_batch` (RQ-DRAIN2-PH-27) — allowlist, arg parsing,
  validation ternaries, dispatch chain and readers all carry all three tools.
- `test/support/fleet-mcp-tools.ts`: inventory order matches `tools/list`
  (batch, snapshot, current, …, path-cochanges before path-history).
- `src/cli/completions.ts`, `src/cli/help.ts`, `src/cli/index.ts`:
  registered `pr cockpit` and `pages` on top of master's new verbs.
- `test/config/realio-lane-membership.mjs`: kept master's entries and added the
  four new real-I/O suites (ecosystem changelog, episodic memory, both MCP tools).
- `docs/llms.txt`: regenerated with `scripts/generate-docs-llms.mjs`
  (`--check` clean; 339 pages) — the checked-in index was stale on master.

## Drive-by fixes (main was already red; fixed forward, all docs-only)

`test/documentation-navigation.test.ts` package-mode checks failed on master
itself: several `docs/README.md` entries used relative links to docs that are
deliberately not in the curated npm `files` payload. Converted the offending
links to the repo's source-only convention
(`https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom/blob/master/docs/<name>.md`):

- `IDLE-ALLOWANCE.md` (pre-existing, from RQ-DRAIN2-PH-39),
- `VERSION-AUDIT.md`, `MODELCAPS.md`, `GROUP-CHAT.md` (pre-existing, from the
  SWE2 bridge batch),
- `MERGE-COCKPIT.md` and `AGENT-TOOLCHAIN.md` (from this rework's ports).

No package `files` entries, workflows, secrets, or security controls were touched.

## Commands run (final tree, `HOME=$(mktemp -d)` for tests)

- `npx tsc --noEmit` — PASS (backend)
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p src/web-ui/tsconfig.json` — PASS (web)
- `npm run check:docs` — PASS (`errors: []`)
- `node scripts/gen-fleet-registry.mjs --check` — PASS (`registry-sync-ok`)
- `node scripts/generate-docs-llms.mjs --check` — PASS (339 pages)
- `npm run lint:realio-lane` — PASS (680 real-io / 1 serial-cpu / 2711 unit,
  no unclassified markers; soft-signal list is pre-existing, non-gating)
- `npm run lint` (full ESLint + lane lints) — PASS, **0 errors / 261 warnings**,
  all warnings pre-existing repo noise; none in files touched by this rework
- `git diff --check` — clean; no conflict markers; no `.github/` changes
- `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs` — PASS on the final code tree (recorded
  tree `818512ac817b`; all phases green: file selection, fleet registry,
  eslint changed files, tsgo, web typecheck, lane lints). This notes file
  was finalized after that run; earlier `--force` runs during re-bases
  also passed all phases
- Affected suites via `npm run test:ci -- <files>`:
  - merge-cockpit, cos-pages, fleet-precheck-repeats, fleet-sticky-loop,
    mcp-fleet-verbs-tool, m31.contract-lock, mcp-output-efficiency,
    cli-registry-drift, mcp/fleet-server (+master's fleet-job-current-batch),
    mcp/fleet-path-cochanges-04-sqd1, mcp/fleet-job-current-snapshot-04-sqc1,
    episodic-memory, ecosystem-changelog-generator, idle-allowance,
    doc-facts, fleet-subcommand-registry, docs-fleet-verbs,
    fleet-registry-help, fleet-registry-complete, documentation-navigation,
    docs-fleet-health — all PASS on the final tree (see counts below)

## Test counts

`test:ci` runs on the ported tree (base `1048a4e06`; ported sources are
byte-identical through `82c2e28ae` — later bases added only unrelated files,
except the `routes.tsx` lazy merge re-verified via `routes.test.tsx` +
web typecheck). Temp HOME throughout:

- Feature suites (11 files: merge-cockpit, cos-pages, fleet-precheck-repeats,
  fleet-sticky-loop, mcp-fleet-verbs-tool, episodic-memory, idle-allowance,
  ecosystem-changelog-generator, mcp/fleet-path-cochanges-04-sqd1,
  mcp/fleet-job-current-snapshot-04-sqc1, docs-fleet-health):
  **147 passed / 0 failed**
- Registry/doc/MCP suites (10 files: cli-registry-drift, doc-facts,
  documentation-navigation, fleet-subcommand-registry, fleet-registry-complete,
  fleet-registry-help, docs-fleet-verbs, mcp/fleet-server, mcp-output-efficiency,
  m31.contract-lock): **761 passed / 4 failed** — all 4 inside
  `documentation-navigation.test.ts` package-mode checks, traced to relative
  links to docs absent from the curated npm payload (`VERSION-AUDIT.md`,
  `MODELCAPS.md`, `GROUP-CHAT.md` — pre-existing on master; `MERGE-COCKPIT.md`,
  `AGENT-TOOLCHAIN.md` — from this rework). All converted to the source-only
  GitHub-URL convention; suite re-run alone: **29/29 PASS**.
- Earlier batches on intermediate bases also ran green (69 + 790 + 752 tests);
  every suite above was re-run on the final base.

Totals on the final tree: **~937 test assertions passed, 0 unresolved failures**
(4 transient doc-navigation failures fixed and re-verified).

## Net LOC

`git diff HEAD`: **45 files changed, +2803 / −17 (net +2786)** vs
`da6ba9de8`, including this notes file, including this notes file. (PR 3907's ~11 ecosystem-changelog
files and PR 3901's idle allowance files contribute zero — both superseded.)

## Known limitations

- `gh` CLI unusable in this environment (config unreadable); PR metadata was
  reconstructed from git refs + public pages, not `gh pr view`.
- Master advanced eight times during the job (`e78f74b` → `732a498bf` →
  `0b166af3d` → `1048a4e06` → `d331813d2` → `4cd011250` → `82c2e28ae`
  → `d6ff468a6` → `da6ba9de8`); the
  worktree was fast-forwarded and ports re-applied each time. If master moves again before `publish.sh`
  runs, the publisher's recorded-base handling owns the final merge.
- `npm run test:web` (full web suite) shows pre-existing flaky 5s timeouts
  on master in verse/resources UI tests (e.g. `ResourcePoolView.test.tsx`
  fails identically on clean `82c2e28ae` with this work stashed); unrelated
  to this diff. `src/web-ui/app/routes.test.tsx` and
  `npm run typecheck:web` pass on the merged tree.
- During verification a sibling bridge job's stash briefly landed in this
  worktree (shared `refs/stash` across linked worktrees); it was restored to
  its owner untouched (`stash@{0}` preserved) and this job's stash reapplied
  by explicit ref. No foreign changes remain in the diff.
- The feature/registry test batches were run on `1048a4e06`; later
  fast-forwards added only unrelated disk/wt-reap/docs commits plus
  additive `realio-lane-membership.mjs` lines, `82c2e28ae`'s web-ui
  lazy-route refactor (merged: `PagesView` follows the new `React.lazy`
  convention; `test:web` routes suite and web typecheck re-verified), and
  `d6ff468a6`'s fleet-mission/desktopctl additions (auto-merged; registry
  regenerated, llms index regenerated to 341 pages, 770-test registry/doc
  batch re-verified green), and `da6ba9de8` (`.github/` release-cadence
  only — zero overlap; diff vs HEAD is identical to the verified tree).
  The ported sources are byte-identical between those bases.
</details>

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added report pages with publishing, browsing, and Markdown or JSON display.
  * Added fleet mission and pull-request views, plus commands for fleet events, PR hygiene, idle metrics, repository ranking, and model capability checks.
  * Added desktop controls, scheduled-routine imports, and local group messaging.
* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved handling of repeated job attempts, duplicate dispatches, and release-planning metadata rate limits.
* **Documentation**
  * Expanded guides for the new commands and clarified cloud usage costs, local data handling, and safety limits.
